gaps.what: Petar Gojnikovic's own page could not be opened under three titles; the dating of his Bosna-valley and Narentine gains (892-917) and Cliopatria's 922 expansion (+24 thousand km2) rest on the main article only (event at confidence 1); Destinikon unlocated; Cliopatria 961 sliver marked wrong

Shapes 936-1000 verified only as 'unverified: page budget'; the 980 jump from 55 to 90 thousand km2 and the 1085 drop of 20 thousand km2 are not explained by any page opened (confidence-1 gain event for 980); royal seats for 928-948 and 998-1057 and rulers for 928-949 are not on the pages

Byzantine suzerainty over Croatia 1018-1025 ('briefly became a vassal of the Byzantine Empire until 1025') is not written as a vassal event here; it belongs in byzantine-empire as vassal_start/vassal_end with counterpart kingdom-of-croatia

Cliopatria's Duklja rows end in 1138 but the page keeps Duklja to 1186; the 1139-1185 keyframe extends the 1126 shape and which lands were lost by 1166 is not stated; Duklja before 1034 (Jovan Vladimir, Samuel's 997 invasion) is not drawn

No separate dossier: Wikidata Q1252942 is shared with great-principality-of-duklja and the page treats one continuous Doclean state, so both Cliopatria Names are reviewed in great-principality-of-duklja

The page's state runs 1091-1217 but the dossier ends in 1168 with Cliopatria's row; 1169-1217 (Nemanja, the 1186 annexation of Duklja, the 1217 coronation) must be carried by kingdom-of-serbia; Uros I-Uros II-Desa reign dates are not on the pages opened

Cliopatria's 1375 shape (1377-1384) is the Kingdom of Bosnia's, to be carried by kingdom-of-bosnia; capital dates (Visoko, Bobovac, Sutjeska) and the extent of Kulin's Bosnia are not on the pages; 1241 loss of the west and north at confidence 1

Normans of Apulia (Count Amico of Giovinazzo, 1074-1075)

problems: Vassal events of the suzerain belong in other dossiers and are not written here: Byzantium over Croatia 1018-1025, over Bosnia 1167-1180, over Raska to 1180, over Duklja/Mihailo; Hungary over Kulin's Bosnia (1180s) and the Subic/Kotromanic vassal-banship 1290-1314. Byzantine-empire (eu-05) and kingdom-of-hungary (eu-15) need them.

grand-principality-of-serbia ends in 1168 only because Cliopatria's row does; the page's state runs to 1217. kingdom-of-serbia (Cliopatria 1188-) must take 1169-1217 and mirror Duklja's 1150-1186 contest and the 1186 annexation; the colour agent should give both one colour.
banate-of-bosnia and the Kingdom of Bosnia are one continuous state (elevated 1377); Cliopatria's Banate row runs to 1384, so its shape 1375 (1377-1384) is for kingdom-of-bosnia to carry.

kingdom-of-duklja is merged into great-principality-of-duklja (both Names in cliopatria_names); principality-of-serbia and grand-principality-of-serbia (shared Q1311990) are kept as two states 130 years apart.
kingdom-of-croatia ends 1102 (coronation of Coloman, successor croatia-in-union-with-hungary which already exists) although Cliopatria's last shape ends 1098; keyframe 1094 is extended to 1091-1102.
principality-of-serbia ends 960 (infobox) although the body says the Byzantine annexation was c. 969-971; Cliopatria's 961 stub is marked wrong.

Page counts and budget: 5 pages each for Croatia, Bosnia, Serbia and Duklja, 2 for the Grand Principality; the Grand Principality article is shared by the Duklja and Grand Principality dossiers (opened once).
